rationale: ENH-3538 reverses ENH-3464 Decision 3, which treated an omitted Codex cache_write_input_tokens as a real zero. Omission-only fixtures do not prove that; BUG-3531 Decision 6 owns the evidence requirement. No cost impact today: Codex models are absent from MODEL_PRICING.
rule: An omitted usage key (e.g. Codex cache_write_input_tokens) is unknown (None), not zero, until matched-capture/producer-contract evidence establishes otherwise.
